messages:
jordan: Heads-up — small customer (acme-inc) reporting SSO failures just after we pushed the RBAC role rename for 'platform-admin' -> 'platform-ops'. They also show SCIM provisioning 403s. I see KMS decrypt errors in provisioner logs. anyone oncall?

mia: on it. can you paste the exact error lines from the provisioner?

jordan: here — grabbed from staging-provisioner logs around 14:02 UTC:
```
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z provisioner ERROR tenant=acme-ext request=PUT /scim/Users/123 status=403 msg="KMS decrypt failed: code=DecryptFailure alias=alias/redwood-acme-v2 ctx-missing"
2026-03-22T14:02:12Z sso-proxy WARN tenant=acme-ext SAMLResponse invalid audience: expected=https://console.redwood.ai got=https://console.redwood.ai/legacy
```

jordan: seems like two things: a KMS alias rotated this morning (deploy note) and some clients hit a legacy Audience URL that we thought covered by redirect mapping.

sam: @mia quick question — did the alias rotation include a rewrap of existing envelopes? iirc we did an incremental rotate for customer aliases at 13:30 UTC.

mia: yes we rotated aliases but did not rewrap active service-account envelopes for all tenants. we queued a backfill but it’s async. acme's tenant id is in the incomplete backfill range.

lee: the audience mismatch looks like a client-side SAML config sending the RelayState/ACS with trailing path. we have a redirect rule but only for exact-match domains. that can explain the login fail but not the SCIM 403.

jordan: agree. SCIM 403 KMS decrypt -> provisioning can't unwrap extid/encryption envelope so makes sense. But acme saw both at once. could be correlated by timing of rotation.

sam: workaround: we can re-run the rewrap job for tenant acme-ext manually. should be quick (few mins) with the backfill worker. Requesting permission to run now.

mia: +1 run it. notify support and add audit note. also capture stacktrace if any other tenants fail.

jordan: doing it now. kicking off backfill job: `./tools/tenant-rewrap --tenant acme-ext --force`

idp-bot: Job queued: tenant-rewrap(acme-ext) by jordan at 2026-03-22T14:06:05Z. JobID=jr-20260322-01

lee: while job runs, I'll open a short-lived mapping rule to accept the trailing path for acme domain: add rule: `allow_saml_audience("https://console.redwood.ai/legacy")` for tenant acme-ext. will keep for 24h.

sam: also adding a monitoring alert to watch KMS decrypt failures per-tenant > 1/min for next hour.

jordan: rewrap finished, logs show success:
```
2026-03-22T14:07:40Z tenant-rewrap INFO tenant=acme-ext job=jr-20260322-01 rewraps=12 status=ok
2026-03-22T14:07:41Z provisioner INFO tenant=acme-ext retrying pending-scim-ops count=3
```

jordan: after rewrap, SCIM requests to acme proceeded. pushing note to support. can we add a postmortem checklist?

mia: yes — action items: (1) ensure rewrap backfill completes within 1h of alias rotate, (2) make rewrap idempotent and auto-trigger for tenants with pending SCIM ops, (3) add unit test for audience redirect matching, (4) create runbook section for "post-rotate provisioning failures".

lee: I'll handle the audience redirect rule cleanup after 24h and open a PR for relaxed matching + test.

sam: I'll add KMS metrics dashboard tiles and an alert runbook entry.

jordan: created incident note in pagerduty referencing JobID jr-20260322-01 and set severity=minor. thanks all. :thumbsup:

idp-bot: Incident update recorded: incident=INC-20260322-7 status=resolved assignees=[jordan,mia,sam]
